summary: Frontend-only validation of /workspace 'Action Workspace' UI for the new per-action multi-provider push feature (HubSpot/Salesforce/Pipedrive) including the new Offer action kind. All acceptance criteria pass: destination selector lists 3 providers, switching between them updates the connected account name and surfaces graceful targets error without white-screening, 6 kind pills render (note/task/call/email/deal/offer), Offer form exposes all 5 fields and locks target type to Deal only, empty-target save shows a clear toast, Deal draft creates a card in the Action queue with provider badge + 'draft' status, Review & push opens a confirm dialog whose title reads 'Push to <ProviderName>?' and preview includes a 'Destination' row, confirm push against demo/invalid HubSpot token flips the card to 'failed' with a readable error line and toast ('HubSpot authentication failed. Reconnect HubSpot with a valid Private App token.'), and the failed card shows a 'Retry push' button plus delete button.

issues: React hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <select>/<option>' — root cause is the Emergent visual-editor injected <span data-ve-dynamic='true'> wrappers around <select> and <option> nodes in the provider dropdown; harmless in preview but adds noise. Not a blocker.

critical_code_review_comments: Workspace.js is 427 lines and mixes state, network, composer, queue, and confirm dialog — approaching the 700-line soft cap but consider extracting <Composer/>, <ActionQueue/> and <ConfirmPushDialog/> for maintainability if additional kinds are added.

loadTargets() swallows errors silently on provider switch (silent:true) — good UX, but the failure state also depends on the targets bar; consider surfacing a subtle inline retry link next to workspace-targets-error.
doPush() catches API errors and toasts e.message, but on 422 the backend detail is passed through correctly. Confirmed graceful — no raw 500 leakage.
target-type-select is disabled via React prop when dealOnly; verified only 'Deal' option is rendered when offer is selected (no Contact option), which is stronger than just disabling.

seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_Draft Deal ($5000) draft via UI to exercise push+failure flow. Left in DB — cleanup optional.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Workspace multi-provider + Offer action UI fully validated end-to-end. Verified selector data-testids: workspace-page, workspace-provider-select (3 opts), workspace-targets-error, kind-{note,task,call,email,deal,offer}, field-offer-{title,amount,discount,expiration,notes}, target-type-select (Deal-locked for offer), save-draft-btn, push-<id>, confirm-dialog, confirm-preview (contains 'Destination' row), confirm-push-btn, delete-<id>. Provider switch tested: salesforce->'Could not reach Salesforce', pipedrive->'Pipedrive authentication failed', hubspot->'HubSpot authentication failed'. Empty-target save toast reads 'Pick a HubSpot record to attach this to'. Dialog title is dynamic: 'Push to HubSpot?' matches action's provider. After confirm push a 422 is returned by backend and UI cleanly shows failed status + 'Retry push' button. No white-screens, no raw 500s.
